Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: Chromatic streaming platform with comprehensive tests

Features:
- Go backend with WHIP WebRTC ingestion, WebSocket signaling, and SQLite storage
- SvelteKit 5 frontend with reactive stores and runes
- Room management with waiting room and password protection
- Stream key authentication for OBS
- Laser pointer and chat functionality
- Watermark overlay system
- Admin dashboard for room and stream key management

Security:
- Constant-time token comparison
- Rate limiting middleware
- CORS configuration
- Security headers

Testing:
- Room handler tests \(CRUD, join, waiting room, admission\)
- Stream key handler tests \(CRUD, validation\)
- Middleware tests \(auth, CORS, rate limiting, headers\)
- Config tests \(env loading, helpers\)
- Database test helper for isolated test databases

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Security hardening: Fix critical vulnerabilities in auth, CORS, XSS, and rate limiting

Phase 1 security fixes:
- CORS: Require explicit ALLOWED_ORIGINS in production mode, shared OriginValidator
- Admin auth: Gate WebSocket admin operations with token verification
- SDP validation: Reject H.264 Main/High profiles that use B-frames \(cause 2s+ latency\)
- Rate limiter: Only trust X-Forwarded-For from configured TRUSTED_PROXIES
- Password policy: Strengthen minimum from 4 to 8 characters
- XSS prevention: Sanitize chat messages server-side, validate file URLs client-side
- Auth: Implement httpOnly cookie sessions \(immune to XSS token theft\)
  - New /api/auth/login and /api/auth/logout endpoints
  - Session tokens stored in Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies
  - Frontend uses credentials: ''include'' instead of localStorage

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
